rows.evidence: This source contributor keeps existing native history/source checkpoint/scope and missing-content handling. The change separates server RecordedThrough from effective-date selection so closing sources can include facts recorded after period end without admitting later-than-cutoff facts. Read-only composition needs no operation receipt; its enclosing production close handler resolves original receipts before re-reading sources and returns typed unavailable/integrity failures before append. Existing TypeI source/publication tests and native TypeII source/replay tests pass.

Reader receives scoped engagement/requester from existing source pipeline; it is not the request authorizer. It publishes only exact captured canonical bytes, verifies tenant/digest/length and verified reopen, and writes a scope-bound immutable manifest. Close handler validates exact period/root/cutoff, complete21-family coverage including empty scans, and exact physical descriptor for every selected reference before native append. Missing/corrupt source and foreign manifest regressions pass; no mutation authority is assigned to the publication helper.

Native close preparation runs after selected receipt recovery; original actor/revision/intent/cutoff and immutable Unit response are checked. Lost-response and equal-winner-after-preparation-failure regressions pass. Real publication/archive regression found missing SourceContentManifest in reconstructed snapshot digest and fixed it. Additional RED proved opening/closing versions of one source were rejected; exact version tuples now normalize and changed-record comparison uses grouped reference sets. The retained complete period State and old approve/freeze/amend producers remain explicit next compact-owner work, not represented as finished.

Scans require exact realm/area/native event identity and program scope, bound complete population, retain full typed fact payloads through accepted cutoff, and confirm the same captured history on a second scan. Current restricted visibility is checked before content publication; a direct regression denies the historical change when current visibility is absent. The enclosing reconciliation maps unavailable content to transient Conflict and integrity failures to permanent Conflict before accepting any close.
